meta.name: Agamana Projects — Design System
meta.description: Canonical brand tokens extracted from the production website. Use these exact values for all creatives and marketing collateral so print, social, and web stay perfectly aligned.
meta.tagline: Your trusted partner in land development — Central & Coastal Karnataka.
meta.notes: The website renders in a single light-forward theme (color-scheme: light). Dark teal is used for premium feature sections, not as a full dark mode.

paper.usage: Primary page background — warm off-white. Default ground for most layouts.

cream.usage: Khaki section background — a calmer, warmer band used to separate sections.

card.usage: Raised white cards on cream/paper grounds.

teal.usage: Dark sections, dark cards, and headings on light grounds. The brand's primary dark.

tealDeep.usage: Darkest surface — hero grounds, modal side panel, deepest contrast.

lime.usage: Signature accent. Primary CTA fill, eyebrow markers, highlights. Use sparingly — one bold moment per view.

limeDeep.usage: Accent hover / pressed state and the eyebrow marker on light grounds.

ink.usage: Primary text — a deep teal-ink, softer than pure black.

inkSoft.usage: Secondary text — body copy, supporting paragraphs.

inkFaint.usage: Tertiary text — captions, placeholders, muted labels.

line.usage: Default borders and dividers on cream grounds.

gradientTextMid.usage: Mid-stop of the lime gradient-text effect (lime → #b8e635 → lime, 135deg).

pairingRules.onLight: ink / ink-soft text on paper, cream, or card. lime-deep for accent marks; solid lime blocks reserved for CTAs.
pairingRules.onDark: white and white/70–85 text on teal / teal-deep. lime for accent text and CTA fills.
pairingRules.accentDiscipline: Lime is the loudest element on the page — limit to one primary action or highlight per view. Never set long body copy in lime.

display.name: Bricolage Grotesque
display.role: Headlines, section titles, display numerals — editorial grotesque with character.

body.name: Inter
body.role: Body copy, UI labels, buttons — maximum legibility.

kannada.name: Noto Sans Kannada
kannada.role: All ಕನ್ನಡ (Kannada) text — consistent rendering across devices for the bilingual brand.

sectionHeading.usage: Section titles (How We Help, Why Agamana …).

eyebrow.usage: Section eyebrow labels above headings, paired with a lime marker line.

rules.measure: Keep running copy near 60–70 characters wide.

principles.reducedMotion: All non-essential animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
principles.meaning: Motion conveys spatial continuity (reveals, slide entrances), never decoration for its own sake.

button.shape: pill (fully rounded), font Inter semibold, gap 10px
button.arrowBadge: Optional 28px circular badge with an up-right arrow that rotates 45° on hover (ArrowCircle).

eyebrow.structure: Lime marker line (28px) above an uppercase, letter-spaced label.
eyebrow.usage: Sits above every section heading for consistent rhythm.

chip.style: Pill, white/10 fill, 1px white/20 ring, backdrop blur, white/90 text, ~13px medium.
chip.usage: Capability tags inside dark image cards.

cardImageOverlay.usage: Legibility scrim on image cards — solid behind bottom text, clear at top so imagery shows through.

gradientText.usage: Premium lime gradient on select display words.

grain.usage: Subtle fractal-noise texture overlay for depth on dark grounds.

buttonShine.usage: Diagonal light sweep across a button on hover.

lockupColor.usage: Full lockup (icon + wordmark) on light backgrounds (navbar, light collateral).

lockupWhite.usage: Full lockup (icon + wordmark) on dark/teal backgrounds (footer, dark collateral).

iconColor.usage: Icon-only mark on light backgrounds — favicons, app icons, avatars, tight/square spaces.

rules.clearSpace: Keep clear space around the mark equal to the height of the 'a' glyph.
rules.minWidth: Keep the wordmark legible — avoid below ~120px wide in print.
dont: Don't recolor the logo outside the brand palette
Don't place the color logo on busy or dark photography — use the white logo
Don't stretch, rotate, or add effects

usageForCollateral.grounds: Default to paper/cream for calm, trustworthy layouts; use teal-deep grounds for premium, high-impact pieces.
usageForCollateral.accent: Lime is the attention magnet — one primary CTA or highlight per piece.
usageForCollateral.type: Bricolage Grotesque for headlines (bold, tight tracking), Inter for everything else. Keep Kannada in Noto Sans Kannada.
usageForCollateral.shape: Large rounded corners (24–40px) and pill buttons are core to the look.
usageForCollateral.photography: Aerial/on-ground land & layout imagery in true colour; apply the bottom-up teal scrim only where text overlaps.
usageForCollateral.bilingual: Every public-facing piece should be available in English and ಕನ್ನಡ.
